summary: NIFTY 50 on NSE_INDEX (token 26000 on Tradejini's NSE segment), one client at Quote and one at LTP: no volume, trade time or book; the change Tradejini sends.

deviations.reason: Tradejini sends the trade time in epoch seconds; the web formats it with the server's local time zone into a text such as "2025-11-05 14:25:31" (nxtradstream.py datefmt) and sends that as ltt, where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends epoch ms, and leaves ltt out when Tradejini sent no trade time, where the web sends null (Quote, Depth) or "" (LTP).
An index has no trades: its L1 carries no ltq, and the web sends last_quantity 0 (message.get("ltq", 0)), an invented zero; the desktop's index frame leaves it out (rules.md: no invented data).
As last_quantity: an index L1 carries no atp, and the web sends average_price 0.
An index's L1 carries no OI; the web sends oi 0. The desktop's index frame carries no OI.
An index's L1 carries no volume; the web sends volume 0 (message.get("vol", 0)), an invented zero. The desktop leaves it out.
The web's server also sends this client a richer mode's publication of the instrument, beyond the modes it holds; the desktop sends one frame per held mode.
deviations.ref: websocket_proxy/server.py zmq_listener (for m in range(1, mode + 1))
